description: Synthetic MinerU middle.json (layout.json), 3 pages 612x792 pt, two-column physics-style paper (columns x 54-300 and 312-558). Page 1: doc_title, authors, affiliations, abstract, keywords, headings (level 1 and 2), body with inline equations, one interline equation with number, a page_footnote, and the head half of a paragraph that continues onto page 2 using MinerU's real cross-page encoding. Page 2: shell + preproc tail, image group, table group (3 columns x 4 rows incl. header), more body. Page 3: results, conclusions, acknowledgments, references as list/ref_text. Every page has header/footer/page_number in discarded_blocks. All geometry is hand-built and self-consistent (lines in blocks, spans in lines), except that the cross_page head lines carry page-2 coordinates by design. _backend=pipeline, _version_name=2.7.1; every page also carries preproc_blocks (pre-merge copies).

tricky_points: Cross-page head block (/pdf_info/0/para_blocks/18): its bbox only covers the 2 physical page-1 lines; the 4 merged lines (6 spans, one inline_equation) have cross_page=true with PAGE-2 coordinates (left column top), so they lie outside the block bbox in the raw file. Recovery must strip them from page 1 and give page 2 the full tail.

The recovered tail contains an inline_equation span that is part of the evidence key (type, content, bbox); the shell on page 2 has the same type/index/bbox as the preproc tail block and lines_deleted=true with lines=[].

Cross-page paragraph is split mid-sentence ('...collected through an objective' / 'with a numerical aperture...'), and the tail's page 2 position is in the LEFT column while the head sat in the RIGHT column of page 1.

image and table groups are containers (blocks[]): only their children become blocks; table caption comes before the table body in blocks[] and in reading order; index of the group equals the first child's index.
The table html uses <th> header cells inside <html><body><table> (3 columns x 4 rows); image_path values are bare 'images/<hash>.jpg'.

References are a single list/ref_text container with 5 child text blocks; the adapter aggregates them into one block (entry boundaries only survive as separate lines), and the list bbox is the union of the children.
Equation number is embedded in the latex as \tag{1}; there is no formula_number block. The prose after it says 'Equation (1)'.
Authors, affiliations and keywords are plain 'text' blocks (as MinerU pipeline emits them): they normalize to body and are translatable. Abstract uses raw type 'abstract'.
Discarded blocks: pages 1-2 have no 'index' (sort after every para_block), page 3 uses explicit indexes -1 / 98 / 99 like the golden fixture.
Every page has 2 header blocks, 1 footer and 1 page_number in discarded_blocks (page_number right-aligned at x 548).
Inline equation spans are glued to punctuation in the source (e.g. '...meV' then ', exceeds'), but the normalized text joins segments with a space (' , ').
Justified lines span the full column width (54..300 or 312..558); first line of each paragraph is indented 9 pt so the block bbox x0 is the column edge but the first line starts at +9.
page_footnote on page 1 sits below both columns (y 745-754) with index after the last body block.
